hints.title: Monotonic Sum of Smallest Elements
hints.text: The sum of the smallest non-banned integers increases monotonically as the upper bound M increases.

hints.title: Analytical Prefix Sum Calculation
hints.text: The sum of all integers up to M is M * (M + 1) // 2. Subtract the prefix sum of banned integers less than or equal to M.

hints.title: Search for Maximum Upper Bound
hints.text: Binary search for the largest M in [1, n] whose net sum does not exceed maxSum, then count valid elements up to M.

hints.title: Binary Search on Upper Bound Implementation

complexity.time: O(B log B + log n * log B)
variables: n: range upper bound up to 10^9
complexity.notes: Sorting banned elements followed by binary search on M using bisection queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through n = 10^9 takes several seconds and exceeds time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(B) memory for banned prefix sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies binary search on answer with analytical arithmetic series and prefix banned deduction.
